name: campaign-planner
description: Use when the user asks to "plan an influencer campaign", "build a campaign blueprint", "track or close a creator campaign", or "record a late campaign correction"; produces the plan and, when requested, a non-canonical evidence tracker with scoped identity, publication, reconciliation, close, and reopen receipts. Not for individual creator briefs — use brief-generator; not for overall product launches without creators — use launch-tier-planner; not for sending, publishing, amplifying, or paying
author: aaron-he-zhu
summary_zh: 用于规划和跟进达人营销活动，生成活动蓝图，并记录发布、核验、结案及重开等凭证。
